status: model of the detect Worker built from subnet/detect-worker (slop-ninja-detect-testnet), which also hosts the DetectGate, DetectFeedback and DetectLane Durable Object classes. Nothing in it is measured on this Worker yet: the JS reserve, glue sizes and stack are the coordinator model's inputs (the same workers-rs 0.8.7, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions, the same hand-written export pattern), so the build uses the arena's unmeasured-model feature together with observe (migration step 1) and links growable linear memory under the ceiling below. Score requests reserve their worst-case footprint from the isolate's scan memory (routes::SCAN_MEMORY_BYTES) in two steps, the intake before reading a body and the rest once its envelope parses; G2 measures the JS reserve and the high-water marks before the model is marked measured.
page_bytes_source: WebAssembly page size, equal to the dlmalloc 0.2.12 system granularity
isolate_bytes_source: Cloudflare Workers limits: "128 MB per isolate", read as 10^6 bytes, the smaller of the two readings
js_reserve_bytes_source: the coordinator model's value (a linear memory ceiling of 1,536 pages), kept so the two models share one unmeasured JS reserve until this Worker's is measured through the inspector; this Worker's routes need far less linear memory than that ceiling
js_envelope_bytes_source: not measured: the largest body this Worker holds in JS before admitting it into linear memory is one chunk of a score request's body stream (the cf_io reader holds one chunk at a time), rounded up to one page of headroom
glue_static_bytes_source: the workers-rs 0.8.7 glue probe (subnet/crates/arena/glue-probe/memory-model.json, local workerd 2026-10-23, round2 run probe1): idle glue 872 B (hand-written exports), rounded up to the next power of two as the stated margin; this crate's lockfile pins the same worker, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions
glue_ticket_bytes_source: the glue probe's largest measured glue per entry with every export hand-written, one ticket per entry: 304 B (waitUntil continuation), rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker's hand-written fetch export (cf.rs) follow the probe's admitted pattern
glue_resident_bytes_source: the glue probe: 24 B per co-resident Durable Object instance, rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker defines three Durable Object classes (DetectGate and DetectFeedback, one instance each; DetectLane, one per Container instance)
min_route_bytes_source: the smallest route control footprint: the 404 route's (routes::OTHER_CONTROL_BYTES, one page), checked by routes::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table
largest_route_bytes_source: the score route's control footprint (routes::SCORE_CONTROL_BYTES: the scorer's reply bound plus 512 KiB) plus the scope's state page; checked by routes::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table. The body-dependent part of a score request is reserved from the scan memory, not from this footprint
stack_bytes_source: rustc wasm32-unknown-unknown links the stack first with rust-lld's default -z stack-size=1048576 (scratch probe, 2026-10-31); the pool starts above static data, so the stack is outside every arena
stack_high_water_bytes_source: not measured on this build: the glue probe's 3,912 B (every workers-rs entry kind), a lower bound
